title: resolve_secret_uri duplicated byte-for-byte in transit and reader main.rs
description: crates/transit/src/main.rs and crates/reader/src/main.rs each contain an identical async fn resolve_secret_uri(value: Option<String>, label: &str) -> Option<String>. Any change to behavior (logging, trim handling, error message format) must be applied in two places. Suggested rewrite: move into a shared helper, either in stoa-core or in a new thin stoa-secretx-helpers module, or add to stoa-tls as it already knows about the secret context.
